text: Agile methodology is a modern approach to project management, especially in software development. Teams work in short cycles called sprints, which usually last two to four weeks. Before each sprint, the team chooses tasks from a prioritized list called the backlog. These tasks are often written as user stories, which describe features from the user's point of view. Every day, team members hold short meetings called standups to discuss progress and problems. This iterative development allows teams to deliver working products quickly and improve them based on feedback.
